results.detail: All 6 steps and triggers match: 5 PrecedenceConstraints with no DTS:Value (= Success), LogicalAnd, linear chain Get Variables -> Create ETL -> Get NonWorkingDays -> Update LastThreeWorkingDays -> Update SuspicionAsEmitted -> End ETL. No disabled executables, no configurations, no event handlers. Step 5 label (status 7 -> 11, three working days after send-to-bank) matches the SQL and the derived constant.

Re-derived: OLE DB source on [Psql] selects gen_transferrequestId where gen_tanferinstatus = 7 and gen_SendToBankDate is not null and datediff(day, ?, gen_SendToBankDate) <= 0, ? = User::LastThreeWorkingDays (ParameterMapping {BCF4D8B7}); Derived Column gen_suspicionAsEmitted = 11; script sets entity["gen_tanferinstatus"] = new OptionSetValue(11) and calls CrmProxy.GetCrmService().Update. Threshold traced in ScriptMain: counter starts at 2 from yesterday, so result = 3rd working day before today. "Sent on or before threshold" = "3 working days or more ago" is correct. No unproven meaning of status 7/11 asserted.

Units [1] and [2] are correct (status 7, sent to bank on/before the threshold; SDK Update to 11; on exception the row goes to the unconnected Error output, so the record is not updated). Unit [3] restates the condition incorrectly.

wrongUnits.problem: "בקשות העברה שנשארו בסטטוס 7 עד יום הסף" ("requests that remained in status 7 until the threshold day") moves the threshold onto how long the status lasted and drops the send-to-bank condition. The code checks only the status at run time (= 7) and that gen_SendToBankDate falls on or before the threshold day; nothing checks status history up to the threshold day.
